definition: [ מִסְחָר ] noun masculine apparently merchandise ; — construct מִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים 1Kgs 10:15 , but text probably corrupt; Klo proposes מִסַּחַר , so Buhl Lex 13 ; || 2Chr 9:14 has הַסֹּחֲרִים , and so Benz here (for both words of MT).

[מִסְחָר] noun masculine apparently merchandise; — construct מִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים 1Kgs 10:15, but text probably corrupt; Klo proposes מִסַּחַר, so BuhlLex 13; || 2Chr 9:14 has הַסֹּחֲרִים, and so Benz here (for both words of MT).
